title: Multi-event reproductive encounter histories of 583 female Daubenton's bat, 6 social groups, 2007-2015
creator: Culina, Antica; Linton, Danielle M.; Pradel, Roger; Bouwhuis, Sandra; Macdonald, David W.
citation: Culina, A., Linton, D. M., Pradel, R., Bouwhuis, S., & Macdonald, D. W. (2018). Dataset (encounter histories of female bats) used in the analysis for the paper Culina et al.: Live fast, don't die young: survival-reproduction trade-offs in long-lived income breeders [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.2222410
abstract: Annual encounter histories of female Daubenton's bat (Myotis daubentonii) in 6 social groups, 2007-2015, each year's capture coded as an event that relates early (pregnancy) and late (lactation) maternity-period observations to the female's reproductive state. The authors fitted a multi-event capture-recapture model with eight states (juvenile, pre-breeder, failed and successful first-time and experienced breeders, skipped breeder, dead) to estimate survival-reproduction trade-offs.
samplingProtocol: Females captured during the maternity period each year and assessed for reproductive condition (weight and/or examination for pregnancy, nipple condition: nulliparous, lactating, post-lactating, parous non-breeding); the year's observations are summarised as one event code.

stateCodes.0: not captured (all states possible, including dead)
stateCodes.1: captured lactating, early capture pregnant or none (successful breeder: SB1, SB2+)
stateCodes.2: captured pregnant early, not captured or unreliable late (FB1, FB2+, SB1, SB2+)
stateCodes.3: captured pregnant early, captured not lactating late (failed breeder: FB1, FB2+)
stateCodes.4: not captured or unreliable early, captured not lactating late (PB, FB1, FB2+, Skip)
stateCodes.5: captured not pregnant or not captured early, captured not lactating late (pre-breeder or skipper: PB, Skip)
stateCodes.6: contradictory or uncertain information (any live state)
stateCodes.7: captured as a juvenile (born in the current season)

closureNote: One annual occasion per year (the year's captures summarised as one event by the authors).
designNote: Multi-event capture-recapture: y is the event code, not the latent state; the readme's table maps each event to its possible states (in stateCodes).
geographicCoverage: United Kingdom: social groups of two sympatric Myotis species (no locations deposited)
covariateNote: unit_social_group: the social group (colony) of the female, as coded in the deposit. unit_first_capture_age: juvenile (born in the year of first capture) or adult.

notShipped.model_output: the paper's multi-event survival and transition estimates
notShipped.males: males are not in the deposit

notes: Females only. A female first caught as a juvenile has rows from that year; one first caught as an adult from 2007 (E4.4).
